column1: Eddy is a stance-heavy mixup character with high damage and strong punishment/whiff punishment. He excels at constantly enforcing high-risk, high-reward 50-50s, like with his "RLX 3,3" and "RLX 4,3" 50-50. Eddy is a very beginner-friendly character that is easy to pick up and find quick success with, and gradually gets harder to win with as you face opponents with stronger defense.
